text_block_list.text:
With a fantastic performance in the
Twinkle
Series, Нарита Таисин has had an
impressive first
three years.

The way she triumphs over the best
despite her
small stature inspires all
those who watch her.

And now, she's become quite the
celebrity.
Нарита Таисин! Can I get a word, please?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
I'd like to speak with you too, if
possible!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр B

text_block_list.text: Oh, uh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Taishin! Can I have your signature?!
text_block_list.name: Taishin Fan

text_block_list.text: ...I guess.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, yay! I'll treasure it for the
rest of my
life!
text_block_list.name: Taishin Fan

text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that Taishin playing over
there?
text_block_list.name: Gamer A

text_block_list.text:
What?! Do you think she'd battle us if
we ask?
text_block_list.name: Gamer B

text_block_list.text: Sigh... This is so exhausting.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Everyone and their mom is asking for
interviews,
and I can't even walk down
the street without
being recognized.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: They're all head over heels for you.

text_block_list.text: Yeah, well...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I hate all this fuss over me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I just want some peace and quiet.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Should I leave you alone, then?

text_block_list.text: Yea—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hang on—no, you're fine.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: You're... You're all right.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
We spend some time together and
quietly
reminisce about the adventures
we've shared.

We talk about the day we met and how I
was
completely blown away by her final
sprint.

And there was the Satsuki Sho, where
the "top
three"—the BNW trio—faced off
in a race that
would become Narita
Taishin's turning point.

There was also the way she seized
victory in the
Arima Kinen through sheer
tenacity.

All in all, we don't exchange many
words, but the
conversation flows
smoothly. It's completely dark
before we
know it.
Whoa, it's night already.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Creek always makes a huge deal and
gets on my
case when I get back late, so
I'd better go.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: What's up? I thought you were leaving.

text_block_list.text:
I used to run so people would
acknowledge me.
It's the same reason I
entered races.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The only thing I was interested in was
running,
winning, and being validated
for doing so well.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: But...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: But now, I really like it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Running, racing... I like it all.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Нарита Таисин smiles after saying this.

It's a pure, lighthearted smile, straight
from her
heart.
